question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

There was no one in the cinema hall beside Sham and Rohan.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**beside**" instead of "**besides**."
 
• "Beside" means next to, while "besides" means in addition to.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**besides Sham and Rohan**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"There was no one in the cinema hall **besides Sham and Rohan**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "in the cinema hall"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "There was no one"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 4.
